verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents assigning a public IP to make a machine accessible over the internet, and offers a private network option at machine creation, with shared drives reachable across machines on that private network. A community user reports hosting Plex servers on Paperspace boxes. There is no documentation of port-level exposure or firewall rules, and almost no detail on how private networking connects instances. Missing for 10: explicit port exposure/firewall configuration docs, detailed private-network setup and instance-to-instance connectivity docs, hands-on corroboration of private networking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Assign a public IP address to your machine to make it accessible over the internet
